name: Bad Bentheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bad Bentheim (a yellow ring of nineteen bezants and interlaced rings on red).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Bentheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Bentheim arms — bezants and rings on red
